summary: THQ and Climax's MotoGP line for Xbox, Windows, mobile, handhelds, and Xbox 360, separate from Namco's PlayStation-format series.

entries.title: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology

emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main route; use Xbox/GBA/N-Gage/mobile only for platform preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology released for Game Boy Advance, Xbox, Windows, mobile phone, and N-Gage. Windows is the selected high-fidelity route, while Xbox is a strong contemporary console route; handheld and mobile releases are lower-fidelity adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version on a compatible PC setup; use Xbox only if preserving the console version and Xbox-era online context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Distinct from Namco's PS2 MotoGP game released under a similar short title in North America.

entries.title: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release; Xbox for online preservation

emulation.emulator: Native Windows / original Xbox or compatible Xbox emulator
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main route and Xbox/Insignia for online preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: MotoGP: Ultimate Racing Technology 2 released for Xbox, Windows, and mobile phones. Windows is the configurable fidelity route; Xbox is secondary only for preserving Xbox Live/Insignia online play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version on a compatible PC setup; use Xbox with Insignia only if preserving original-Xbox online multiplayer.

secondary.exclusive_content: Xbox Live online multiplayer, now playable through the Insignia replacement service.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the Xbox version for online multiplayer preservation.
secondary.why: Windows is the fidelity route; Xbox has the sourced online-service preservation path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Xbox Live is discontinued; Insignia is the cited preservation route.

entries.title: MotoGP '06

emulation.notes: Use Xbox 360 hardware or compatible preservation setup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox 360 presentation with emulator scaling where compatible

primary.why: MotoGP '06 is sourced as an Xbox 360-only THQ/Climax game based on the 2005 and 2006 MotoGP seasons. With no other platform documented, Xbox 360 is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a compatible Xbox 360 preservation setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced PC or PlayStation release for this THQ entry.

entries.title: MotoGP '07

emulation.notes: Use Xbox 360 hardware or compatible preservation setup; PC version may need old-driver/workaround preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox 360 presentation with emulator scaling where compatible

primary.why: THQ's MotoGP '07 released for Xbox 360, Windows, and mobile phone, but the PC version has specific issues such as a corrupt Yamaha M1 model and crowd rendering problems on post-2010 graphics drivers. Xbox 360 is the cleaner primary route; Windows and mobile have no content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox 360 hardware or a compatible Xbox 360 preservation setup; use Windows only if you want PC-specific preservation despite the sourced issues.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with Capcom/Milestone's PS2-only MotoGP '07; same license season, different game branch.
